> 第十四章 血影门（第1页）
“是的，白骨真经！”叶苍柏神色凝重的说道：“十年前，武林中突然从塞外杀入一批邪派高手，为首的叫‘塞外双魔’，带着‘四凶’、‘九怪’和‘十煞’等黑道中人席卷整个武林，引起一场腥风血雨。当时武林中两位领袖带着武林群雄与魔道高手展开了殊死之战，一位是‘北刀’鉄赶山，一位便是你父亲‘南剑’萧英枫。那场大战惨烈无比，武林中很多人士如昆仑、点苍、峨眉等各派高手都死伤在那次厮杀中，就连北刀铁老英雄也在立诛塞外双魔的一战中力竭身亡。最后萧大侠终于带着剩下的武林好汉杀进塞外双魔的老巢，摧毁了大本营，并在其城堡内搜出了邪道的至尊武学宝典《白骨真经》，却不想因这部《白骨真经》又引起了一场武林争端。”
萧无恨冷笑道：“就因这部《白骨真经》，你们就杀害了我父亲。”
叶苍柏道：“怪只怪老夫当时糊涂，错信了小人！你可知那《白骨真经》端得是一本奇书，听说里面记载了邪派中至高无上的武学秘籍，自从此书出现之后，黑道中每二十年都会出现一批高手，弄的武林腥风血雨，一片狼藉。萧大侠得到此书后便决定，将此书在武林人士面前公开毁掉。但他的这个决定却引起了他四位结拜兄弟的不满！”
“那四位结拜兄弟是否就是慕容秋、上官复、欧阳长青和骆一禾？”萧无恨问道。
叶苍柏答道：“不错，这四人一起找你父亲问道：‘好不容易出生入死，战败塞外双魔拿到了《白骨真经》，为什么不研究一下却要毁掉？’你父亲却说这本书太过邪恶，那塞外双魔只学会了书里五六成的功夫，便已经弄得武林大乱，若要是以后黑道中再有人领会里面十成的武学，恐怕天下再难有人制止，不如乘早毁掉。四人见你父亲一意孤行，便私下约了帮手一起到你家中要书，当时骆一禾与我颇有交情，便骗我说：‘萧英枫一定是自己私下重新翻录了这本书，然后故意毁掉原本，掩人耳目，我们一起去把书要回来，大家好好研究一番，也免得这其中发生其它问题。’我便信了，和他一同前往。谁知……”
叶苍柏重重的叹了一口气，道：“谁知道我们去了之后，却莫名地和萧大侠起了冲突，起了一场混战，我后来才知道中了骆一禾他们四人的挑拨离间之计，但却为时已晚，酿成了一场惨剧。事后这场杀戮被保密起来，江湖上只说萧大侠为了保护《白骨真经》被黑道所杀，知道真实情况的只有当时去的十三个人。”
“那这白骨真经现在哪里？”萧无恨问道。
“后来，为了这部《白骨真经》武林中人在华山展开了比武，说是武功最高者得之，结果评比出了新的江湖十大高手，而排在首位的却是慕容秋、上官复、欧阳长青和骆一禾四人。只因这四人谁也胜不了谁并列第一，后来便将《白骨真经》一分为四，每人各持半部。”
叶苍柏说到这里叹息道：“这部白骨真经出现的一百多年间，黑白两道多少人为此而死，兄弟反目成仇，只有你父亲萧大侠不为所动，要将此不祥之物毁灭，只可惜为时已晚！现在看来，那上官复四人早已谋划好了一切，其他的人都不过只是棋子。那天去的一十三人中，除了四人之外还有九人，其中四人战死在当场，剩下的五人包括老夫在内，只看见白骨真经的影子，什么也没有得到，你说可不可笑！”
萧无恨道：“可笑？我只知道‘欠债还钱、杀人偿命’，你犯下的错便用你的命来还！”

> Chapter 14 Blood Shadow Gate (Page 1)
"Yes, the White Bone Scripture!" Ye Cangbai said solemnly: "Ten years ago, a group of evil sect masters suddenly entered the martial arts world from outside the Great Wall. The leader was called the 'Two Demons Outside the Great Wall', accompanied by the 'Four Evils', 'Nine Monsters' and 'Ten Evils' and other gangsters. The Zhongren swept through the entire martial arts world, causing a bloody storm. At that time, two leaders in the martial arts world led the martial arts masters to engage in a life-and-death battle with the magic masters. One was the "North Sword" Tie Ganshan, and the other was your father "Nan Jian" Xiao Yingfeng. The battle was extremely brutal, and many martial arts masters such as Kunlun, Dian Cang, and Emei were killed or injured in that fight. Even the old hero of Beidao Iron also died of exhaustion in the battle to slay the two demons outside the Great Wall. In the end, Daxia Xiao finally took him with him. The remaining martial arts heroes rushed into the lair of the two demons outside the wall, destroyed the base camp, and found the evil supreme martial arts book "The White Bone Manual" in their castle, but they did not want to cause another martial arts dispute because of the "White Bone Manual."
Xiao Wuhen sneered: "Just because of this "White Bone Scripture", you killed my father."
Ye Cangbai said: "It's just that I was confused at the time and mistakenly believed in the villain! Did you know that the "White Bone Scripture" is a strange book? I heard that it records the supreme martial arts secret book among evil sects. Since the appearance of this book, every two people in the underworld have A group of masters will appear every ten years, causing chaos in the martial arts world. After getting the book, Master Xiao decided to destroy it publicly in front of the martial arts people. However, his decision aroused the dissatisfaction of his four sworn brothers! "
"Are the four sworn brothers Murong Qiu, Shangguan Fu, Ouyang Changqing and Luo Yihe?" Xiao Wuhen asked.
Ye Cangbai replied: "Yes, these four people came to your father together and asked: 'After all the hard work, we defeated the two demons outside the Great Wall and got the "White Bone Scripture", why did we destroy it instead of studying it?" Your father said that this book was too evil. The two demons outside the Great Wall only learned 50% to 60% of the kung fu in the book, but they had already caused chaos in the martial arts world. If someone in the underworld understands 10% of the martial arts in the book, it will be difficult for anyone to stop it. It would be better to destroy it as soon as possible. When the four of them saw that your father was determined to have his own way, they secretly arranged for help to go to your house to ask for the book. Luo Yihe, who was very close to me at the time, lied to me and said: 'Xiao Yingfeng must have reprinted the book in private and then deliberately destroyed it to hide it from others. Let's go and get the book back so that we can study it carefully to avoid other problems. ' I believed it and went with him..."
Ye Cangbai sighed heavily and said: "Who knew that after we went there, we would inexplicably have a conflict with Master Xiao and have a scuffle. I later found out that I fell into the trap of Luo Yihe and the four of them to sow discord, but it was too late and it resulted in a tragedy. Afterwards, the killing was kept secret. People in the world only said that Master Xiao was killed by the underworld in order to protect the "Book of Bones". Only the thirteen people who went there at the time knew the true situation."
"Then where is the White Bone Scripture now?" Xiao Wuhen asked.
"Later, for the "White Bone Manual", martial arts contestants held a competition in Huashan. It was said that the person with the highest martial arts skills won it. As a result, the new top ten masters were selected, and the top ten were Murong Qiu, Shangguan Fu, Ouyang Changqing and Luo Yihe. Just because no one of these four could beat the other and tied for first place, the "White Bone Manual" was later divided into four, each holding a half."
Ye Cangbai sighed when he said this: "In the more than a hundred years since this White Bone Scripture appeared, many people from the Black and White Taoists have died for it, and brothers have turned against each other. Only your father, Daxia Xiao, remains unmoved. It is a pity that it is too late to destroy this ominous thing! It seems now,The four of them, Shangguan Fu, had already planned everything, and the others were just pawns. Among the thirteen people who went that day, in addition to four, there were nine people. Four of them died on the spot. The remaining five people, including the old man, only saw the shadow of the White Bone Scripture and got nothing. Don't you think it's ridiculous! "
Xiao Wuhen said: "It's ridiculous? I only know that 'pay debts with money, murder with life', the mistakes you made will be repaid with your life! "
